title: Downloads over the device connection
spec: Request 13 Download { file, offset, length (1 to MAX_CHUNK) }, under FEATURE_FILES, is answered Ok { cursor: n } then a bytes frame (tag 134: id, u32 n, n bytes): the file's bytes from offset, at most length, fewer at the end, none past it. DurableServer::download checks on every request that the file is recorded and that the person is a member of its room now; otherwise NotFound, answered E_NO_SUCH_FILE alike for a file that does not exist, one in a room the person was never in, and one in a room they left. Without storage it is NoStorage (E_NO_STORAGE), also from the in-memory server.
